title: Switch to a vision-capable model
description: 换看图模型 button in the editor composer vision notice opens the assistant model picker when a needsVision attachment is present and the selected model cannot see images

kimiUi.appearsWhen: a parsed image attachment exists while the selected model cannot see images

preconditions.notes: Product-only control; the frozen Kimi capture has no composer attachment flow

steps: Attach an image in the editor composer with a text-only model selected, then click 换看图模型 in the notice below the attachment chips

evidence.network: GET /slides/models for inputModalities; POST /api/attachments/upload when applicable

expectedNative.uiParityNotes: Product attachment UX; no direct Kimi counterpart captured
